title: Mars in Aries
caption: mars in aries has never once played hard to get. it fights loud, forgives fast, and means it

lines: You've *never* once played hard to get.
Mars rules Aries, so here it's home,
and it moves *first.*
When you're angry, it's *loud* and it's *over.*
Ten minutes later you're fine,
and confused why they aren't.
You need someone who can say it *straight back.*
Say it with me.
My directness is a kind of *honesty.*
I can go first and wait for an answer.
Wanting someone out loud is *brave.*

title: Mars in Taurus
caption: mars in taurus wants slowly, and then wants for years. it never pushes. it stays

lines: Slowly. That's how you *want.*
And then you want for *years.*
Mars in Taurus is the *slow burn* of the zodiac.
Taurus is fixed earth.
You chase with patience, not pressure:
dinner, then dinner again, then a key.
In a fight you go *quiet* and *immovable.*
You need someone who doesn't push, just *stays.*
Say it with me.
Nobody gets to rush my heart.
My stubbornness is *loyalty* in disguise.
When I choose, I choose *for good.*

title: Mars in Gemini
caption: mars in gemini flirts in paragraphs and fights in footnotes. silence is the one thing it can't take

lines: You flirt in *paragraphs*
and fight in *footnotes.*
Mars in Gemini chases with words.
Gemini is ruled by Mercury,
so desire starts in your *head.*
In a fight you'll talk it to pieces,
and you need someone who talks back,
not someone who goes *silent* for days.
Say it with me.
I fight to *understand,* not to win.
My words can be gentle and still be true.
I want someone who stays in the *conversation.*

title: Mars in Cancer
caption: mars in cancer would go to war for the people it loves, and can barely ask for a hug

lines: For the people you love, you'd go to *war.*
For yourself, you can barely ask for a *hug.*
That's Mars in Cancer.
Cancer is ruled by the Moon,
so your drive rises and falls like a *tide.*
You chase sideways, like the crab,
and when you're hurt, you go into your *shell.*
Say it with me.
I can say *I'm hurt*
instead of saying nothing.
Wanting to feel safe first is not *weakness.*

title: Mars in Leo
caption: when mars in leo wants you, everyone knows. flowers at work, a toast at dinner, the whole heart

lines: When you want someone, *everyone* knows.
Flowers at work. A toast at dinner.
Mars in Leo chases with its whole heart.
Leo is fixed fire, ruled by the Sun.
You burn steady and *proud.*
So in a fight, it's rarely the thing itself.
It's whether you still feel *respected.*
Say it with me.
My pride is how I *protect* my heart.
I can lower my voice and *keep* my crown.
I want someone who's proud to be *mine.*

title: Mars in Virgo
cover: Mars in Virgo fights with a *plan*
caption: mars in virgo has a draft of this fight, rehearsed in the shower. twice. it just wants the real fix

lines: Somewhere there's a *draft* of this fight,
rehearsed in the *shower.* Twice.
Mars in Virgo fights with a plan.
Virgo is ruled by Mercury,
so your drive is precise and practical.
You want someone through effort,
booking the table, learning their order.
And in a fight, you want the *real* problem,
not a speech. An actual fix.
Say it with me.
I can be *right* and still be *kind.*
Not everything I love needs *fixing.*
Including *me.*

title: Mars in Libra
caption: mars in libra cares more about peace than winning. that isn't weakness. it fights for what's fair

lines: Peace matters more to you than *winning.*
But Mars in Libra isn't weak.
It fights for what's *fair.*
Libra sits opposite Aries,
the sign Mars rules,
so your drive points toward *another person.*
You chase with charm, never pressure,
and you need a partner who fights *fair,* too.
Say it with me.
Keeping the peace can't cost me *my voice.*
I'm allowed to want things out loud.
Fair includes being fair to *me.*

title: Mars in Scorpio
caption: mars in scorpio doesn't chase. it decides, then waits like the tide. just don't make it guess

lines: Before *Pluto* was ever found,
Scorpio was ruled by *Mars.*
So yours is at home, and it runs deep.
You don't chase. You *decide,*
and then you're patient as the tide.
In a fight you go quiet,
and you remember *everything.*
So hear this, Scorpio.
You don't need someone to *match* your intensity.
Just someone who says it now,
and never makes you *guess.*

title: Mars in Sagittarius
caption: mars in sagittarius says the true thing first and the kind version an hour later. working on it

lines: You say the *true* thing first,
and the kind version an hour later.
Mars in Sagittarius shoots *straight.*
You chase what makes you feel alive:
a last-minute flight, a dare, a laugh.
Freedom isn't a phase for you. It's *oxygen.*
You need someone who'd explore, not control.
Say it with me.
I can be *honest* and *gentle* at once.
Wanting room doesn't mean I want *out.*
I'm looking for a fellow *adventurer.*

title: Mars in Capricorn
caption: mars in capricorn wants people the way it climbs mountains. slowly, on purpose, all the way up

lines: You want people the way you climb *mountains:*
slowly, on purpose, all the way up.
Mars is *exalted* in Capricorn,
the sign where its fire learns *patience.*
Your wanting is slow, and built to *last.*
In a fight you go calm and practical,
which can look cold, but it's *care.*
You need someone who knows the difference.
Say it with me.
My feelings are not a *problem* to solve.
I can let someone see me soft.
Patience is my kind of *passion.*

title: Mars in Aquarius
caption: mars in aquarius will argue for a stranger all night, then go quiet about its own hurt. feelings count too

lines: Injustice can keep you up all *night.*
Your own hurt, though, goes *quiet.*
That's Mars in Aquarius.
Aquarius is fixed air,
so your desire lives in your *mind.*
You chase the person who surprises you,
and in a fight you reach for logic
when what you really feel is *hurt.*
Your feelings count,
even the *illogical* ones.
The right person will be your *friend* first,
and let you be free and close at once.

title: Mars in Pisces
caption: mars in pisces has said sorry for fights it didn't start. its gentleness has a spine

lines: You've said sorry for fights you didn't *start.*
Mars in Pisces would rather soften
than ever win by *hurting* someone.
Pisces is mutable water,
so your drive moves like a current,
around things, never straight *through.*
You chase with imagination:
a playlist, a letter, a whole daydream.
Say it with me.
My gentleness has a *spine.*
I can stay *kind* and still say no.
My needs belong in the room *too.*
